title: Relative algebraic closure of a subfield in an extension
statement:
Let $E/F$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. The *algebraic closure of $F$ in $E$* (the maximal algebraic subextension) is the set

$$
\{\alpha\in E:\alpha\text{ is algebraic over }F\}
$$

of elements of $E$ algebraic over $F$ [def-weil-algebraic-element], regarded as a subfield of $E$ containing the image of $F$ (an intermediate field of $E/F$): it contains $F$ and is closed under sums, differences, products and inverses of nonzero elements (Stacks, Lemma 09GI). It is an algebraic extension of $F$.
